name: Panama
description: Panama from the first peoples and Balboa to the gold road, Colombia, independence in 1903, the canal and its handover in 1999.

checkpoints.name: Spanish isthmus
checkpoints.note: Balboa crossed to the Pacific in 1513. Gold and silver from Peru crossed Panama, and Morgan sacked the city in 1671.

checkpoints.name: Part of Colombia
checkpoints.note: Panama joined Colombia in 1821. A French canal failed in the 1880s.

checkpoints.name: The canal
checkpoints.note: Panama broke away in 1903, and the United States built the canal, opened in 1914. Noriega was removed in 1989.

checkpoints.name: Panama's canal
checkpoints.note: Panama took over the canal at the end of 1999 and widened it in 2016.
